_comment: 67r: RECOVERY: as 67n but the truth carries an east-west correction growing linearly over 1966-2023 (basis cos(pi x), weight .5).

E067: one smooth spatiotemporal habitat correction h(cell,t) = sum_b S_b(cell) w_b t (15 land-centred cosines, n_freq 3; linear in time over 1966-2023, held before, obs-centred), shared by all four fields and carried into path habitat via the path operator (precomputed A.S). Prior N(0, .1) per weight. Restores, on H and with guards, the original March st_basis correction.
